name: Changwon Defense-Dedicated AI Data Center (AIDC), Palyong-dong / Changwon National Industrial Complex
developer: Dinotisia; Dinocore; Shinhwa Steel; Gyeongsangnam-do; Changwon City
notes: Investment MOU for a 100MW defense-focused AI data center in Palyong-dong, Changwon National Industrial Complex; reported investment about KRW 1.6555 trillion, planned construction start 2027 and completion target 2031.

name: Geoje City data center attraction effort with KT
notes: Geoje officials visited KT's Gimhae IDC and requested cooperation for attracting a data center to Geoje; source says KT reacted positively, but no later confirmed site, permit, capacity, or construction evidence was found in this pass.

name: KT cloud Gimhae DC / Global Datacenter (Gimhae GDC)
notes: kt cloud lists Gimhae DC as a Yeongnam-region data center and global hub/disaster-recovery-specialized facility; kt cloud service documentation identifies a southern DR zone at Global Datacenter (Gimhae GDC). Capacity not disclosed in located sources.

name: Goseong-gun data center attraction plan
notes: Local reporting says Goseong-gun planned to attract a data center as a future growth project, with opposition concerns and a 2024-2026 planning horizon mentioned; no confirmed private developer, capacity, approval, or construction evidence was found in this pass.

name: Hamyang AI Data Center, Hyucheon General Industrial Complex
notes: Final permits reportedly completed April 9, 2026 for phase 1 of a KRW 1.38 trillion AI data center project at Hyucheon General Industrial Complex; first phase is 40MW on 42,738 square meters, construction planned in 2027 and operations from 2028.
